about: Expected values for the gor3d-selftest v1 receiving comparator (tools/depth_analysis/selftest_check.py). Budgets are v1 first-run bounds for the owner Mac on the synthetic 36-frame clip; tighten from the first real good log.

thermal.policy: s19: level 0 nominal / 1 fair acceptable for the short self-test; 2 serious or 3 critical fails

precision.rule: moge fp16_used>=1 OR fp32_used>=1 (fp32 is the sanctioned fallback); fp16_rejected>0 is a finding, both zero fails

depth.count_note: count = frames * box.nw * box.nh where box = VDAStream.letterbox(clip W x H) from the log's clip note (s22/ce1ab092: depth is cropped to the letterbox picture; for 640x360, box = 266x150 so 36f -> 1436400, NOT the full 266x154 canvas). Fallback when no clip note: full canvas frames*266*154 with a finding.

first_3d_frame_sha256.bit_exact: NOT expected: the hash covers an HEVC encode of a Metal render fed by CoreML fp16 inference - all three vary across OS/build/hardware. A recorded reference (set expect to the owner Mac's first good value) can only pin same-machine same-build reruns; DIFFERS is a warning, never a fail.
